title: Scope overlap conformance vectors
note: Invariant I3: overlap may over-report, it must never under-report. Every case here is one an implementation must get exactly right. Overlap is decided on the patterns, so a collision on a file that does not exist yet counts, and a claimed path is treated as covering its subtree.

cases.name: identical files
different files in one directory
file inside a claimed directory
directory inside a claimed tree
the nesting check works in both directions
sibling directories are disjoint
a prefix that is not a path boundary is not nesting
extension globs in the same directory are disjoint
cases.note: No filename ends with both .ts and .js. Earlier builds reported these as overlapping because they compared literal prefixes; that answer was safe but wrong, and the same imprecision hid the real collisions below.

cases.name: a deep glob covers a nested file
root globstar covers everything
root globstar overlaps itself
top-level files are disjoint from directories
multi-pattern scopes overlap if any pair does
multi-pattern scopes stay disjoint when no pair overlaps
brace alternation overlaps one of its branches
brace alternation stays disjoint from an unlisted branch
a bare directory name nests like a tree
a star pattern collides with a future file that does not exist yet
cases.note: Nothing on disk matches either pattern. Comparing materialized file lists answers 'no' and hands the same future file to two owners.

cases.name: two star patterns collide on a directory neither one names
cases.note: Both match ab/x.ts. Neither has a literal prefix, so a prefix comparison cannot see it.

cases.name: star patterns whose literal parts cannot agree stay disjoint
a top-level star pattern collides with a future top-level file
a top-level star pattern does not reach into a directory
a claimed path covers files that will appear under it
cases.note: build may not be a directory yet. Claiming a path claims what will live under it.

cases.name: a single-segment star can become a directory over a deeper claim
question marks collide with any single character
character classes that share a member collide
character classes with no shared member stay disjoint
a negated class is treated as colliding
cases.note: A negated class excludes a finite set from an unbounded alphabet. Answering 'may collide' is the safe direction.

cases.name: brace alternatives collide if any branch does
brace alternatives stay disjoint when no branch collides
a globstar in the middle reaches any depth
a globstar in the middle collides once a leaf could become a directory
cases.note: src/a/b/spec/x.ts/test/y matches both once x.ts is a directory. Claiming a path claims its subtree, so this over-reports for a path that stays a file. Over-reporting costs a claim; under-reporting costs the file.
